intro: Paying for a home, reporting a breakdown and asking for someone to fix it.
p.casero.consejo: Its feminine is «la casera». It is the person you pay the rent to.
p.alquiler.consejo: It comes from «alquilar». The qu sounds k: al-ki-LER.
p.hipoteca.consejo: The h is silent: i-po-TE-ka. It is paid every month for many years.
p.recibo.consejo: It is the regular payment for a service: «el recibo de la luz», «el recibo del agua».
p.comunidad.consejo: In a building, «la comunidad» are the neighbours who share costs. It ends in -dad: it is feminine.
p.avería.consejo: The v sounds like b and the accent splits i-a into two syllables: a-be-RÍ-a.
p.gotera.consejo: It comes from «gota». It is water that falls through the ceiling of a house.
p.fontanero.consejo: Its feminine is «fontanera». In Latin America «plomero» is also used.
p.estropearse.consejo: It is said about objects: «se ha estropeado la lavadora». «Se ha roto» is also used.
p.arreglar.consejo: The rr sounds strong: a-rre-GLAR. It also means to tidy up or make something look nice.
p.calefacción.consejo: It ends in -ción, like «canción»: it is feminine and has an accent.
p.lavadora.consejo: It comes from «lavar». The v sounds like b: la-ba-DO-ra.
p.enchufar.consejo: It comes from «enchufe». The opposite is «desenchufar».
p.encender.consejo: It changes e to ie: «enciendo». The opposite is «apagar».
b1.texto:
You pay the **alquiler** to the **casero**, or the instalments of the **hipoteca** to the bank. Every month the **recibos** arrive: electricity, water and gas. In a building with neighbours you also pay the **comunidad**.

If an appliance fails, we say **se ha estropeado** or that there is an **avería**: se ha estropeado la **lavadora**. To use it you must **enchufar** and **encender**. A **gotera** is water falling through the ceiling.

To ask someone to **arreglar** it, you call the **fontanero** and say: **necesito que venga**.
b2.f0.texto: I am the tenant of the third floor.
b2.f2.texto: Have you switched it on properly?
b2.f3.texto: And there is a leak in the bathroom.
b2.f4.texto: I need someone to come today.
b2.f6.texto: I'll send the plumber tomorrow so that he fixes it.
b2.f7.texto: I hope he won't take long.
b2.f9.texto: I'll notify the building's management so they check the leak.
b4.texto:
To ask another person for something, we use a verb of wish or need + **que** + **subjunctive**:

- **Necesito que venga** un fontanero.
- **Quiero que lo arreglen** hoy.
- **Espero que no tarde.**

To say the purpose of an action: **para que** + subjunctive:

- Mando al fontanero **para que lo arregle**.

If the subject is the same, «que» is not needed and the infinitive is used: **Necesito arreglarlo** hoy.
b4.e0.texto: I need a plumber to come.
b4.e1.texto: I call the landlord so that he sends someone.
b5.f0.texto: The night falls cold over the red-brick building.
b5.f1.texto: Inside the flat, the heating keeps an icy silence.
b5.f2.texto: Sara wraps herself in a thick blanket and drinks a hot tea.
b5.f3.texto: In the bathroom, a leak marks time with small, regular drops.
b5.f4.texto: The water draws a dark circle on the white ceiling.
b5.f5.texto: In the morning, the plumber knocks on the door with two soft taps.
b5.f6.texto: He carries a toolbox and a blue cap.
b5.f7.texto: With a small torch, he checks the ceiling, the pipes and the boiler.
b5.f8.texto: The boiler starts working again with a calm hum.
b5.f9.texto: Sara touches the warm radiator and smiles, relieved.
b6.o0.refuerzo: That's it! After «necesito que» comes the subjunctive: venga.
b6.o1.refuerzo: «Viene» is indicative. After «necesito que» you need the subjunctive.
b6.o2.refuerzo: The infinitive is used if the subject is the same. Here it changes: someone else comes.
b6.pregunta: You ask someone to do something. Which form is missing?
b7.o0.refuerzo: The alquiler is paid for using a home that is not yours.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Well done! The hipoteca is the bank loan to buy the home.
b7.o2.refuerzo: The comunidad is the group of neighbours in the building, not the loan.
b7.pregunta: You buy a flat with a bank loan. What do you pay?
b9.frase: Mando al fontanero para que lo ____.
b9.o0.refuerzo: After «para que» you need a conjugated verb, not the infinitive.
b9.o1.refuerzo: «Arregla» is indicative. After «para que» comes the subjunctive.
b9.o2.refuerzo: That's it! «Para que» asks for the subjunctive: para que lo arregle.
b9.pregunta: It is the purpose of the visit. Which form is missing?
b10.pregunta: Write in Spanish: «The heating has broken down.»
b11.o0.refuerzo: A hipoteca is a loan, not water in the ceiling.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Yes! A gotera is water falling through the ceiling.
b11.o2.refuerzo: A lavadora is a machine for washing clothes.
b11.pregunta: Water drips from the bathroom ceiling. What do you have?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Well done! Se ha estropeado: it has stopped working.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Enchufado means connected to the power: it does work.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Encendido means switched on: it does not say that it no longer works.
b12.pregunta: The washing machine no longer works. Which participle is missing?
p.inquilina.consejo: Feminine of «inquilino». The qu sounds k: in-ki-LI-na. She pays rent to the «casero».
p.encendido.consejo: Participle of «encender». The c before e sounds th: en-then-DI-do.
p.arregle.consejo: Subjunctive of «arreglar». It follows «para que»: «para que lo arregle».
p.espero.consejo: «Esperar» can mean to wait and to hope: «espero que no tarde».
p.revisen.consejo: Subjunctive of «revisar», after «para que». The v sounds like b: rre-BI-sen.
p.llamo.consejo: Form of «llamar» for «yo». The ll sounds y: YA-mo. «Llamar a alguien» also means to phone.
p.mande.consejo: Subjunctive of «mandar», after «para que»: «para que mande a alguien».
p.funcione.consejo: Subjunctive of «funcionar», after «espero que»: «espero que funcione».
p.ladrillo.consejo: The ll sounds y: la-DRI-yo. «De ladrillo rojo» describes the material of a building.
p.helado.consejo: It comes from «hielo». The h is silent: e-LA-do. Also, «un helado» is an ice cream.
p.envuelve.consejo: Form of «envolverse»: the o becomes «ue». The v sounds like b: en-BWEL-be.
p.golpes.consejo: The singular is «el golpe». It can be a knock at a door or a hit.
p.regulares.consejo: Plural of «regular»; it has the same form for masculine and feminine. The initial r is strong.
p.gorra.consejo: The rr is strong: GO-rra. It is feminine: «una gorra».
p.linterna.consejo: It is feminine: «una linterna». It lights up dark places.
p.tuberías.consejo: The accent splits í-a: tu-be-RÍ-as. The singular is «la tubería».
p.caldera.consejo: It heats water for the home. It is feminine: «la caldera».
p.funcionar.consejo: It is for machines, not people: «la calefacción funciona». Opposite: «estar estropeado».
p.radiador.consejo: The initial r is strong and the stress is at the end: rra-dya-DOR. It is masculine.
p.tibio.consejo: It is written with b: «tibio». The «io» is one syllable: TI-byo.
p.aliviada.consejo: Feminine of «aliviado», from «aliviar». The v sounds like b: a-li-BYA-da.
